_source: AI-researched NEW DISTRICT candidates for Manchester and Cheshire, awaiting review — never directly promoted by the research agent. Populated by the same daily scheduled research agent as venue-suggestions.json (2026-08, at explicit user request), committed straight to master the same way (see that file's own doc comment for why). Expected to be rare: the research brief (.claude/agents/curia-research-daily.md) treats district suggestions as an occasional finding (a genuinely distinct, not-yet-covered high-end area within Manchester or Cheshire), not a daily quota — most days should add zero entries here. The daily curia-suggestion-review agent (.claude/agents/curia-suggestion-review.md) is the only thing that promotes an entry into the real docs/data/districts.json, behind its own pull request. Each entry mirrors docs/data/districts.json's own raw shape (name/metro/lat/lon/base/kind/accentColor/editorialDescription) so an approved entry can be copied straight in, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) stripped on promotion. `metro` must be 'manchester' or 'cheshire' only — never 'los-angeles' or a new metro (out of scope, per the user's explicit 'shouldn't go beyond cheshire and manchester just yet').
_reviewWorkflow: Same as venue-suggestions.json: status starts 'pending', the review agent flips it to 'approved' (then copies fields into districts.json, as part of its own PR) or 'rejected' (kept here with researchNotes so it isn't re-suggested). A human's real review happens by reading/merging that PR.
_promotionNote20260912: Nantwich, the sole entry sitting here as of 2026-09-12, was independently re-verified and promoted into docs/data/districts.json by curia-suggestion-review the same day — see that file's own note for the re-verification detail. Removed from this queue per the standard promote-and-remove step.

suggestions.name: Chester
suggestions.editorialDescription: Roman walls two thousand years old still ring the centre, and the Rows stack a second storey of shopfronts above the first — a working city that happens to be standing on its own ruins. The kind of place that earns its queue outside the better rooms, not just its postcard.
suggestions.researchNotes: Mandatory every-run district check (per this file's own 2026-09-03 correction): Chester is a genuinely distinct, nationally well-known Cheshire city — the county's actual city, with city status, a cathedral, the UK's most complete Roman/medieval walls, and the double-decker Rows — that none of this app's existing 20 districts meaningfully cover; the nearest existing Cheshire district, Nantwich, sits roughly 17 miles south with a wholly different (small market-town) character. Passes the 'a local would raise an eyebrow it's missing' test more strongly than several of the smaller villages already added (Bramhall, Heaton Moor). Verified via Wikipedia, visitcheshire.com, walkingfoodtoursuk.co.uk and Great British Life: a real, current, independent-heavy food and drink scene distinct from any existing district (Sticky Walnut in Hoole, The Coach House celebrating 20 years independent, Pink Lettuce, Whitmore & White deli/wine merchant, Maray) alongside the Rows/city-walls/cathedral as genuine Do-category draws. Coordinates centred on the Eastgate Clock (the second most-photographed clock in the UK after Big Ben, at the junction of the four main Rows streets) — a real, precise landmark, not an invented approximation. kind 'city' (not 'county') reflects Chester's genuine urban density and night economy (a university population, a real late-evening bar scene), distinct from the sleepier market-town curve already used for Macclesfield/Nantwich/Knutsford. accentColor is a sandstone-red (#A6512F) for the city's defining red-sandstone walls and buildings, checked for perceptual distinctness against every existing accent — closest neighbours are Ancoats' rust-brick (#9C5030, more orange/brown) and Nantwich's faded brick-clay (#A56A52, notably lighter/pinker) — distinct from both, and Chester is never zoomed alongside either given the real distance involved. No venues seeded yet — same starting point every prior district promotion has had before its own first venue pass; that's separate follow-up work for the review agent or a future research pass, not done here.
